title: Compute counterflow exchanger effectiveness
prompt: Implement solve(payload) using the counterflow effectiveness-NTU model. hot_capacity_w_per_k and cold_capacity_w_per_k are positive heat capacity rates; ua_w_per_k is nonnegative conductance. inlet_hot_c and inlet_cold_c are temperatures in Celsius; their ordering is unrestricted. Cmin=min(Ch,Cc), Cr=Cmin/max(Ch,Cc), NTU=UA/Cmin. If Cr==1 exactly use effectiveness=NTU/(1+NTU); otherwise e=exp(-NTU*(1-Cr)), effectiveness=(1-e)/(1-Cr*e). Q=effectiveness*Cmin*(Th-Tc), positive from the named hot stream to the named cold stream. Return {"effectiveness":...,"heat_w":Q,"outlet_hot_c":Th-Q/Ch,"outlet_cold_c":Tc+Q/Cc}. Nonpositive capacity or negative UA returns {"error":"invalid_exchanger"}. Input scales avoid overflow; implement small-NTU behaviour without rounding. Any numeric inputs are finite; inputs have the documented shapes; unspecified validation is out of scope. Do not mutate payload or any nested value. Numeric absolute tolerance 1e-7, relative tolerance 1e-9; strings, booleans, errors and collection shapes must match exactly.
